# Introduction

Wild beehives are structures found in Abandoned Houses, Abandoned Villages and Draugr Village in the Meadows. They are also found in Contested Towers in the Black Forest.

## General

When destroyed, they drop one Queen bee and 1 to 3 Honey.
When attacked, they deal 10 poison damage in a 4-meter radius. They also attack every 4 seconds if the player is too close.
